title: Alpine Hut in the Snowy Mountain Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. The staged robbery (scratched safe, untouched watch, taped window/footprints) is itself a red herring the culprit built into the scene; Kanazawa's weak alibi (alone in the bath) is a second red herring the transcript supports only as suspicion, with no stated motive against the victim, so no fabricated has_motive_against edge was added for him. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: The blood on the table stops in a clean line, and the sofa where the bloodied lighter was later found has no blood on it at all -- proving the tablecloth and lighter were moved to their found positions only after the blood had already dried, i.e. someone returned to the scene after the murder.

Each of the four assistants' and the victim's names contains a kanji character used for a different shogi piece, missing only the 'horse' (knight) that Dr. Oyama had earlier joked about; the one square on the tablecloth with long blood trails (the edge of the table) matches the starting square of the 'lance' piece, spelling out Kaori Nakahara's name as Dr. Oyama's dying message.

Nakahara could not say how much the snacks she supposedly just bought cost, because she had actually purchased them in bulk that same afternoon while shopping for dinner, then only pretended to drive to the store that evening to build her alibi window.

edges.detail: presents Kaori's gene-therapy paper to the university as his own work
tells her no one would listen if she claimed authorship herself, but society would pay attention if a famous professor published it
buys large quantities of snacks that afternoon while shopping for dinner, ahead of the requests she would 'take' that evening
takes everyone's snack orders around 9:00pm and pretends to drive to the convenience store, actually doubling back with the snacks she had pre-bought that afternoon
scratches the safe to make the murder look like a botched robbery
tapes the window and leaves staged footprints outside to fake a break-in

edges.method: ties him up, then repeatedly stabs him, puncturing both lungs so he suffocates over 10-15 minutes

edges.detail: while dying, marks the tablecloth with a bloodied lighter at the shogi-piece square corresponding to Kaori's name
returns to the scene around 11pm to 'discover' the body
notices the dying message, removes the tablecloth from the table, and moves the bloodied lighter onto the sofa

edges.motive_type: revenge for stealing and publishing under his own name the gene-therapy paper she spent six years writing in memory of her father, who died of the disease it addressed
